'''Jericho Donovan''' was a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] and the older sister of [[Josephine Donovan]], whom she hated immensely, and daughter of [[James Ortell Donovan]]. She was an excellent [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], but lacked [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]] skills.

==Biography==
===Rebel without a cause===
A rebel by nature, Donovan did everything she could to spite her father. She was sent to the [[Mindabaal Royal Academy]] boarding school for troubled teens. There she became engaged in [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] and reprogramming [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]] [[Computer/Legends|computers]], unbeknownst to the academy instructors. After graduation she and some classmates stole her father's [[Mindabaal Custom|Mindabaal pleasure yacht]], the ''Royal Flower'', and renamed it ''[[Jericho's Pride]]'' and set off on a career in smuggling and [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]], severing all ties with the Donavan family.

===Reunion===
Years later, she raided a [[Mindabaal]]ite ship and managed to kidnap the Mindabaalite [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]], who turned out to be her own sister. When they returned to Mindabaal, they found that it had been devastated in an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|planetary bombardment]]. From that day on, the sisters teamed up determined to thwart the Empire through smuggling and crime. Jericho would especially make use of her criminal and persuasive skills.

==Behind the scenes==
Jericho Donovan shares her name with [[Wikipedia:Jericho|Jericho]], a city in [[Wikipedia:State of Palestine|Palestine]].
